description: Circle of the Shepherd Druids bond deeply with animals and can grant them gifts of power.

features.name: Speech of the Beasts
features.description: You can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language, and you gain advantage on animal handling checks.

features.name: Animal Influence
features.description: Animals within 30 feet that can hear you have advantage on saving throws against magic.

features.name: Herd Bond
features.description: Your wild companion gains additional hit points equal to your Druid level and deals extra damage.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.description: When reduced below half hit points, you can summon beast allies to aid you.
